title: Senior HR Administrator
description:
As a Senior HR Administrator in Littlehampton, you'll take care of the day-to-day running of HR processes in the professional services industry. Your role will help ensure everything runs smoothly by managing key administrative tasks and supporting the HR function.

Client Details
- This role is based within the professional services industry in Littlehampton.
- Demonstrate high degree of integrity and maintain confidentiality.
- Demonstrate basic understanding of the business, industry, clients, and business processes of assigned business.
- Be proficient at providing instruction/information to employees in the use of HR programs, tools, services.
- Demonstrate proficiency in conducting HR analytics (accurately analyses data, identifies trends and presents in a clear and logical manner that allows users to quickly interpret and identify appropriate action).
- Takes personal accountability & initiative - identifies issues (pro-active); take action to resolve (can-do); go beyond what is required (ownership).
- Strong interpersonal skills.
- Ability to prioritise.

Description
- Onboard new clients and establish their HR policies and systems.
- Prepare HR documents such as employment contracts and new hire guides.
- Co-ordinate induction sessions and ensure all documentation is completed, recorded, and communicated effectively.
- Review and update company policies.
- Liaise with external partners such as Occupational Health, HRIS providers and legal compliance.
- Create regular reports and presentations on HR metrics (e.g. turnover rates, stability, absence).
- Proactively manage varied HR Information systems, updating records in a timely manner (e.g. starters, leavers, maternity, holiday).
- Monitor and manage client HR in-boxes, responding where appropriate and escalating to HR Advisors where needed.
- Support HR Advisors and HRBPs by ensuring all disciplinary, grievance, absence and performance management cases and outcomes have been captured, recorded and logged in the relevant HRIS
- Ensure the accurate recording and archiving of all employees related documents and correspondence in line with GDPR and Data Protection legislation.
- Update the HR System with sickness reasons and ensure medical certificates and return to work interview forms are received and filed.
- Process leavers on the HR System and ensure all associated paperwork is actioned and distributed as required.
- Provide timely employment references when requested in accordance with policy.
- Administer the maternity process by issuing maternity information and processing paperwork/updating the HR System.
- Ensure the client Organisation charts are kept up to date with leavers and staff changes.
- Answer phone & email queries about HR admin related activities.
- Perform other related duties as assigned or requested.
- Assist payroll providers by providing relevant employee information (e.g. leave, absence, sick days and work schedules).
- Provide accurate and timely administration support to our team and clients.
- Ensure all correspondence are prepared to a high standard with a 'right first time' approach to detail.
- Participate in HR projects
- Act as first line advisory support to clients for employment enquiries and for direct client relationships where assigned.

Profile

A successful Senior HR Administrator should have:
- CIPD qualified to at least level 5 or equivalent occupational qualifications.
- Comprehensive and up to date knowledge of relevant ER and HR related legislation.
- 3 years of experience within a relevant HR role.
- Excellent customer service skills.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills.
- Can flex communication style according to listener / audience.
- Loves working as part of a team but also self-motivated and disciplined.
- Analytical and problem-solving abilities.
- Comprehensive understanding of HR legal requirements and best practices.
- Excellent knowledge of employment contracts and terms and the application of typical HR processes.

Job Offer
- An hourly rate of £16.00 to £18.00, dependent on the level of experience.
- Monday to Friday 9:00am until 5:00pm, 30 minutes for lunch
- 2 days a week in office, 3 days WFH
- Initial 6 week assignment

If you're interested in this role, apply now.
